title: DataCollator routed academic/technical sources to a non-existent 4th expert label
trigger_conditions: FlexOLMo SFT with expert routing labels
root_cause: _source_name_to_expert_label produced a one-hot at index 3 for academic/technical sources, but the deployed model only had 3 active experts (indices 0..2 plus a masked duplicate). The label tensor pointed to an unused expert slot, so router supervision was silently directed to a slot the router never produced gradient for.
invariant: Expert label one-hot indices must lie within the active expert range of the model; 'general' must subsume any source not assigned to a specialized expert.
diff_summary: Drop the academic/technical fallthrough into label[3]; route all non-math, non-code sources into the General expert (label[1]).
silent_check: Buggy collator yields valid float tensors of shape (4,) and the rest of the pipeline accepts them — training proceeds, but router supervision for academic data is silently misdirected.
